استعضنا (form X)
# اِسْتَعَضْنَا (istaʕaḍnā) /is.ta.ʕadˤ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
# اُسْتُعِضْنَا (ustuʕiḍnā) /us.tu.ʕidˤ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
